latest_cos_commentary.headline: Restroworks (formerly Posist) is an India-founded, globally expanding cloud unified restaurant technology platform serving 20,000+ locations, including several global chain brands.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius primarily on POS and back_office/kitchen_drive_thru unification, positioning itself as a single platform replacing legacy multi-vendor POS stacks for multi-national restaurant brands.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Completed a rebrand from Posist to Restroworks, reflecting a strategic shift from POS-only vendor toward broader unified restaurant platform positioning aimed at global enterprise chains.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: When Restroworks appears in international or multi-brand accounts, emphasize Genius's North American payments-processing depth and support network versus a platform with roots in Indian/APAC markets expanding globally.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Named brand relationships (Taco Bell, Subway, etc.) likely reflect specific franchisee or regional-market deployments rather than company-wide global rollouts; verify exact scope before citing to a specific account.
